text:
incident-bot: PAGERS: High-severity alert - cross-tenant routing anomaly detected in dedicated-pool gpud-23 in us-west-2 :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Affected customers: cust-117 (VPC), cust-88 (dedicated), potential prefix overlap with cust-117's VPC prefix. Error rate spiked for routed requests to cust-88 endpoints.
ashley (eng-oncall): I'm awake, on it. Can someone confirm whether this is routing table drift or an app-layer misroute?
kevin (infra): grabbing net routes now. running `routectl dump --pool gpud-23 --json | jq '.routes | select(.prefix|test("cust-117"))'`
kevin (infra): hit: there's a stale route entry with prefix 10.41.0.0/16 pointing at node set for cust-88. Looks like a control-plane reconciliation missed an eviction.
maria (sre): observed 5xx spikes for cust-117 requests going to cust-88 logs around 02:07 UTC. sample log: `GET /v1/generate 200ms -> forwarded to gw.cust-88`
samir (serving-runtime): if KV cache prefix re-use occurred we can get cross-customer responses. We need to confirm KV shard assignment. running `kv-check --pool gpud-23 --shard-status`
samir (serving-runtime): KV shows shard s-42 still bound to cust-88 tenant-id on 3 nodes, one node showing mismatch header `X-Tenant: cust-117` in logs.
ashley (eng-oncall): big — possible exposure. Immediate mitigations: 1) isolate infected node(s) from routing, 2) evict caches and rotate tenant keys for affected customers, 3) notify CS to prepare customer comms.
kevin (infra): isolating node gpud-23-n12 now: `poolctl isolate gpud-23-n12 --drain` — drain in progress (ETA ~30s).
ashley (eng-oncall): deploy-bot, pause new allocations into gpud-23 while we investigate.
deploy-bot: RECEIVED: pause-allocations gpud-23 by ashley — acknowledged.
riya (customer-success): cc @kevin @ashley I'll start reaching out to cust-117 and cust-88 with tentative hold notice. Need impact window and whether PII may be involved.
samir (serving-runtime): forcing KV eviction on drained node: ```
ssh gpud-23-n12
sudo systemctl stop redwood-runtime
redwood-kvctl evict --shard s-42 --force
```
kevin (infra): evict succeeded. node isolated. I'm also checking control-plane audit: `auditctl logs --since 02:00 --filter pool=gpud-23` — found a reconciliation job at 02:04 that returned 500 and retry path didn't clear stale route. filing a ticket to retry mechanism.
maria (sre): quick verification: replayed customer request trace; response headers include `X-Routed-From: gpud-23-n12` for a cust-117 request that should never hit cust-88. Snapshot saved: `/var/tmp/incident/1765129999/trace-4971.json`
ashley (eng-oncall): good work. Now rotate tenant signing keys for both cust-117 and cust-88 to prevent cached tokens being reused. samir, can you coordinate with keys team?
samir (serving-runtime): already pinged keys-service. Issuing rotate: `keysctl rotate --tenant cust-117 --notify false` and same for cust-88. Note: rotation will require clients to pick up new tokens; plan minimal disruption window and coordinate with CS.
riya (customer-success): for cust-117: flagged as enterprise VPC with regulated data. I'm drafting holding message: "We observed a routing anomaly affecting your dedicated pool; we've isolated the impacted node and are rotating keys and replaying logs. No confirmed data exfiltration yet; root cause under investigation. We'll provide updates every 30 mins."
kevin (infra): control-plane fix: pushing reconciler patch to make route reconciliation idempotent and retry on 500s. patch: `gh pr create --title 'reconciler: retry route reconciliation on transient 500' --base main` — will canary to staging then prod after approval.
maria (sre): monitoring: set synthetic checks for tenant-prefix mapping in gpud pools. `monitorctl create --name prefix-mismatch-gpud --expr 'prefix_map_mismatch > 0' --alert-channel incidents`
ashley (eng-oncall): status update for pager: node isolated, KV eviction complete, tenant keys rotation initiated, control-plane reconciler patch proposed. Impact: cust-117 saw increased error rate for ~7m; cust-88 responded to some foreign requests but we have not found exported payloads in logs beyond headers.
riya (customer-success): informing procurement + security leads at cust-117 per their SLA. They're asking for log evidence and ETA to close. Asking for a short timeline.
samir (serving-runtime): ETA for keys rotation + full verification ~45 mins. I'll attach verification checklist when done.
kevin (infra): leaving a remediation note in ticket: `TICKET-3772: stale-route-reconciliation-fix` and scheduling a postmortem.
ashley (eng-oncall): handoff: I'm swapping to daytime oncall at 1765130200 — @maria you'll take on-call for active followups. Please keep me looped, I'll be reachable for escalations.
maria (sre): ack taking over. I'll coordinate with CS and keys team for verification.
riya (customer-success): thanks — I'll send follow-up to both customers and tee up legal if needed.
incident-bot: PAGE CLOSED by ashley at 1765130405 — followup thread will remain open in #incidents for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
